Awesome-DSH-Pet is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Extensible desktop-pet plugin for the DSH Web GUI, with feed / play / character-switch menus and Codex 8x9 spritesheet characters.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-48eff19b99d7c67886ee.html
